description: This file provides utility functions for sanitizing, detecting, and processing HTML content, including XSS filtering, HTML tag detection, and HTML to text conversion.

methods.name: sanitizeHtml
methods.description: Sanitizes an HTML string to prevent XSS attacks using the configured filter.

methods.name: hasHtmlTagPattern
methods.description: Checks if a string contains an HTML tag pattern based on known tags.

methods.name: isProbablyHTML
methods.description: Heuristically determines if a string is likely to be HTML content.

methods.name: sanitizeHtmlIfNeeded
methods.description: Sanitizes the HTML string only if it is detected as HTML.

methods.name: safeHtmlSpan
methods.description: Returns a React span element with sanitized HTML if input is HTML, otherwise returns the string.

methods.name: removeHTMLTags
methods.description: Removes HTML tags from a string, returning only text content.

methods.name: isJsonString
methods.description: Checks if a string is valid JSON.

methods.name: getParagraphContents
methods.description: Extracts contents of paragraph tags from HTML string.

methods.name: extractTextFromHTML
methods.description: Converts HTML string to plain text if input is HTML.
